isolation: Separate benchmark workspace and dependency lockfiles; no studio integration, source-plan changes, sibling project writes or production assets
assets: Synthetic shapes and locally available system text only; no model calls or downloads of media

shots.subject: A synthetic voice-note waveform becomes transcript lines
The same transcript remains visible while a selection is clarified
An intentionally different newsletter composition with a recognizable rectangular subject
A matching rectangular review panel receives a simple comparison and settles

procedure: Pin actual compatible package versions and inspect their distributed license files; preserve notices.
Implement the identical shot timing, visual brief and holds in separate engine-native prototypes.
Typecheck/build both prototypes before playback or export.
Record local preview URL and review the full 12-second interval at natural speed.
Inspect every boundary interval and specified frame; a still alone is not a motion pass.
Seek nonsequentially, checking that repeated target frames reproduce the same state.
Compare a change limited to shot 3, checking that other shot states remain unchanged.
Produce silent local exports only within the approved experiment scope, then verify dimensions, fps, duration, frame count, hashes and full decode.
Record cold/warm render time and memory with actual hardware, Node, browser, codec and package versions. Preserve failures; do not estimate missing results.
Repeat three measured warm runs per engine if the benchmark budget allows; report sample count and medians only for actual completed runs.
Compare same-engine repeated output/frame hashes under controlled encoding; do not require equal hashes between different renderers.
Record human playback findings separately from machine checks and licensing/integration evidence.
selectionRules: Both intentional cuts and continuous transformation must work and be reviewed.
The player must support reproducible stable project URLs and reliable frame inspection.
Preview/export correctness and permitted intended use are gates; convenience alone cannot override a failure.
When both pass, prefer simpler verified React-studio integration and targeted revisions; diagram authoring benefits may favor Motion Canvas if evidenced.
Record the selected package/version, tradeoffs, unresolved limits, evidence and explicit decision. No selection is recorded before execution.
